answer:
To set the embedding model globally, assign it on the `Settings` object. The docs show this pattern:

"Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]

`Settings` is a global singleton that supplies defaults for any component you don't pass in directly: "Whenever a particular component is not provided, the `Settings` object is used to provide it as a global default." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]

If you don't set the embedding model, LlamaIndex falls back to `text-embedding-ada-002`. For new projects, the docs recommend choosing a current model explicitly: "We recommend doing this for new projects." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]

For the LLM, the excerpts show the same `Settings` mechanism and an Ollama example, but not the exact `Settings.llm` assignment line, so I can't quote it. The migration guide shows that `Settings` applies to every module: "Configuring the global settings means you are change the default for EVERY module in LlamaIndex." It also imports Ollama: "from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/service_context_migration.md]. The LLM is probably set as `Settings.llm = ...`, but please confirm this in the full settings page [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md], which lists the configurable attributes.
